# ThreadKnotFilter

Whether a thread listing shows cut threads (knots).

**Kind:** a string enum, used in requests.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Exclude"` | Only living threads: a knot is not something you know, only something you let go. |
| `"Include"` | Living threads and knots together. |
| `"Only"` | Only knots: what was let go, and why. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.
